verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a crawl endpoint that returns Markdown for linked pages in one response, up to 500 pages. A background batch crawl handles up to 25,000 pages and lets you track progress and retrieve results. A vendor-cited customer (SiteGPT) uses it to scrape entire websites. Missing for 10: single-request crawling is capped at 500 pages and framed as for 'a small website section', larger sites need the async submit-and-poll flow, and no independent hands-on evidence confirms full-site crawl reliability.
